subject.title: Add package changelog previews for plugin publishing

question: Should plugin release publishes use an access-gated auto-generated package changelog preview for existing packages, rather than staying manual-only?
rationale: The branch adds new user-visible preview behavior and a public package action, so a maintainer should accept the product and access-role contract even after the narrow prompt-label fix.

options.title: Accept gated auto-preview after prompt fix
options.body: Keep the PR direction, require package-specific OpenAI prompt labels, and treat owner/publisher/staff access as the intended boundary.

options.title: Narrow the access contract
options.body: Keep auto-preview but restrict existing-package preview generation to package admins or another smaller role set before merge.

options.title: Keep package changelogs manual-only
options.body: Close or re-scope the PR if maintainers do not want generated package changelog previews in the publish flow.

recommendation.title: Accept gated auto-preview after prompt fix
recommendation.body: Keep the PR direction, require package-specific OpenAI prompt labels, and treat owner/publisher/staff access as the intended boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main history owner for the package publish route and backend surfaces touched by the PR.
